subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “The flute showed that art is not a luxury that appears after life becomes easy.”?
options: It is part of being human.
Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Humility is part of progress.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The flute showed that art is not a luxury that appears after life becomes easy. It is part of being human.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Technology changes objects, but human behavior remains part of every system.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Human knowledge made it welcoming.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The flute showed that art is not a luxury that appears after life becomes easy. It is part of being human.」，答案為「It is part of being human.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「It is part of being human.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
